name: shield
description: Shield Advanced This is the Shield Advanced API Reference.

subcommands.name: associate-drt-log-bucket
subcommands.description: Authorizes the Shield Response Team (SRT) to access the specified Amazon S3 bucket containing log data such as Application Load Balancer access logs, CloudFront logs, or logs from third party sources.

subcommands.name: associate-drt-role
subcommands.description: Authorizes the Shield Response Team (SRT) using the specified role, to access your Amazon Web Services account to assist with DDoS attack mitigation during potential attacks.

subcommands.name: associate-health-check
subcommands.description: Adds health-based detection to the Shield Advanced protection for a resource.

subcommands.name: associate-proactive-engagement-details
subcommands.description: Initializes proactive engagement and sets the list of contacts for the Shield Response Team (SRT) to use.

subcommands.name: create-protection
subcommands.description: Enables Shield Advanced for a specific Amazon Web Services resource.

subcommands.name: create-protection-group
subcommands.description: Creates a grouping of protected resources so they can be handled as a collective.

subcommands.name: create-subscription
subcommands.description: Activates Shield Advanced for an account.

subcommands.name: delete-protection
subcommands.description: Deletes an Shield Advanced Protection.

subcommands.name: delete-protection-group
subcommands.description: Removes the specified protection group.

subcommands.name: delete-subscription
subcommands.description: Removes Shield Advanced from an account.

subcommands.name: describe-attack
subcommands.description: Describes the details of a DDoS attack.

subcommands.name: describe-attack-statistics
subcommands.description: Provides information about the number and type of attacks Shield has detected in the last year for all resources that belong to your account, regardless of whether you've defined Shield protections for them.

subcommands.name: describe-drt-access
subcommands.description: Returns the current role and list of Amazon S3 log buckets used by the Shield Response Team (SRT) to access your Amazon Web Services account while assisting with attack mitigation.

subcommands.name: describe-emergency-contact-settings
subcommands.description: A list of email addresses and phone numbers that the Shield Response Team (SRT) can use to contact you if you have proactive engagement enabled, for escalations to the SRT and to initiate proactive customer support.

subcommands.name: describe-protection
subcommands.description: Lists the details of a Protection object.

subcommands.name: describe-protection-group
subcommands.description: Returns the specification for the specified protection group.

subcommands.name: describe-subscription
subcommands.description: Provides details about the Shield Advanced subscription for an account.

subcommands.name: disable-application-layer-automatic-response
subcommands.description: Disable the Shield Advanced automatic application layer DDoS mitigation feature for the protected resource.

subcommands.name: disable-proactive-engagement
subcommands.description: Removes authorization from the Shield Response Team (SRT) to notify contacts about escalations to the SRT and to initiate proactive customer support.

subcommands.name: disassociate-drt-log-bucket
subcommands.description: Removes the Shield Response Team's (SRT) access to the specified Amazon S3 bucket containing the logs that you shared previously.

subcommands.name: disassociate-drt-role
subcommands.description: Removes the Shield Response Team's (SRT) access to your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: disassociate-health-check
subcommands.description: Removes health-based detection from the Shield Advanced protection for a resource.

subcommands.name: enable-application-layer-automatic-response
subcommands.description: Enable the Shield Advanced automatic application layer DDoS mitigation for the protected resource.

subcommands.name: enable-proactive-engagement
subcommands.description: Authorizes the Shield Response Team (SRT) to use email and phone to notify contacts about escalations to the SRT and to initiate proactive customer support.

subcommands.name: get-subscription-state
subcommands.description: Returns the SubscriptionState, either Active or Inactive.

subcommands.name: list-attacks
subcommands.description: Returns all ongoing DDoS attacks or all DDoS attacks during a specified time period.

subcommands.name: list-protection-groups
subcommands.description: Retrieves ProtectionGroup objects for the account.

subcommands.name: list-protections
subcommands.description: Retrieves Protection objects for the account.

subcommands.name: list-resources-in-protection-group
subcommands.description: Retrieves the resources that are included in the protection group.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Gets information about Amazon Web Services tags for a specified Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in Shield.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds or updates tags for a resource in Shield.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from a resource in Shield.

subcommands.name: update-application-layer-automatic-response
subcommands.description: Updates an existing Shield Advanced automatic application layer DDoS mitigation configuration for the specified resource.

subcommands.name: update-emergency-contact-settings
subcommands.description: Updates the details of the list of email addresses and phone numbers that the Shield Response Team (SRT) can use to contact you if you have proactive engagement enabled, for escalations to the SRT and to initiate proactive customer support.

subcommands.name: update-protection-group
subcommands.description: Updates an existing protection group.

subcommands.name: update-subscription
subcommands.description: Updates the details of an existing subscription.
